chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fadhal, from al-Hasan ibn Jahm who said:

I said to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): We have a group who have love (for us), but they do not have that firm resolve, though they profess this belief? He (peace be upon him) said: Those are not those whom Allah admonished; rather, Allah said: So take lesson, O men of insight.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between having love for the Imams and having firm resolve in Shia theology?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) distinguishes between mere affection and firm resolve (azimah), clarifying that those with love but lacking resolve are not the primary subjects of divine admonition. This distinction highlights the Shia emphasis on the integration of emotional devotion with intellectual conviction, referencing the Quranic call for reflection by those of insight. The hadith underscores that true belief requires both the heart's attachment and the mind's discernment.
